BUSINESS STUDIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #2
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: BUSINESS STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Procurement is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Procurement as rumours only.
   B. Explain Procurement with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Procurement.
   D. Say Procurement never happens in Kenya.

2. Which statement about The Ledger is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say The Ledger never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat The Ledger as rumours only.
   C. Explain The Ledger with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing The Ledger.

3. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Hide all money underground
   B. Avoid saving forever
   C. Plan income and spending wisely
   D. Ignore prices in shops

4. Which statement about Methods of Price Determination is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Methods of Price Determination as rumours only.
   B. Say Methods of Price Determination never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Methods of Price Determination.
   D. Explain Methods of Price Determination with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

5. Which statement about Cash Books is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Cash Books.
   B. Say Cash Books never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Cash Books as rumours only.
   D. Explain Cash Books with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

6. Which statement about Marketing is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Marketing.
   B. Treat Marketing as rumours only.
   C. Say Marketing never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Marketing with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

7. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nairobi
   B. Kisumu
   C. Nakuru
   D. Mombasa

8. Which statement about Financial Markets is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Financial Markets never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Financial Markets with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Financial Markets.
   D. Treat Financial Markets as rumours only.

9. Which statement about Entrepreneurship is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Entrepreneurship.
   B. Say Entrepreneurship never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Entrepreneurship as rumours only.
   D. Explain Entrepreneurship with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

10. Which statement about Consumer and Investor Protection is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Consumer and Investor Protection.
   B. Treat Consumer and Investor Protection as rumours only.
   C. Explain Consumer and Investor Protection with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Consumer and Investor Protection never happens in Kenya.

11. Which statement about Savings and Investments is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Savings and Investments with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Savings and Investments never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Savings and Investments.
   D. Treat Savings and Investments as rumours only.

12. Which statement about Types of Business Ownership is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Types of Business Ownership with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Types of Business Ownership never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Types of Business Ownership.
   D. Treat Types of Business Ownership as rumours only.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Trial Balance and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Cash Books and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Savings and Investments and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Financial Markets and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
